name: To the Top
summary: Marli Wishrunner offers you a view from one of Feralas's twin colossals, with one warning: the way up is one way.

sections.title: One Way Up
sections.body: Marli Wishrunner can send you to the top of one of Feralas's twin colossals for a view. She warns you to think about how you will get down. The journey goes only one way.

faq.q: Who can send you to the top of a colossal?
faq.answer: Marli Wishrunner, who can send you up one of Feralas's twin colossals to take in the view.
You reach the top of one of the twin colossals.

faq.q: Does Marli provide a way back down?
faq.answer: No. Marli warns that the journey goes only one way, so think about how you will get down.
